question: A falling head permeameter is set up to measure the hydraulic conductivity of a silty sand sample. The sample is a cylinder $8 \text{ cm}$ in diamterer and $22 \text{cm long}$. The burette has a diameter of $2 \text{ mm}$. At the start of the test, the head difference across the sample is $80 \text{ cm}$. Assuming the sample's hydraulic conductivity is $10^{-4} \text{ cm/s}$, estimate how much time will elapse before the head difference across the sample reduced from $80$ to $20 \text{ cm}$. Give your answer in whole seconds
